baseline_models.focus_anchor: The idafa joins word 1, food, to word 2, the emphatically sinful person, so the eater's identity qualifies the intake.
baseline_models.mechanism: Literal ingestion is coupled to lagging from good: the food can be read as an intake fitted to, and bodily enacting, the eater's moral delay rather than as a neutral possession.

activation_trace.role: Tasting and taking food supplies the literal bodily intake through which the eater's condition can be enacted.
Slowing and lagging from good gives the sinner a directional condition that the intake can embody.

changed_reading.after: An intake congruent with the eater's settled lag from good, making moral condition bodily rather than merely possessive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same idafa can relate an allotted provision to the person whose sin is being requited.
baseline_models.mechanism: The food-root includes provision, livelihood, and assigned share, while the sin-root includes punishment of sin; together they permit a ration-like reading in which the sinner receives his penal allotment.

activation_trace.role: Provision, livelihood, and a legal share turn food into an apportioned due rather than only an edible object.
Recompense for sin supplies the punitive content of that apportioned due.

changed_reading.after: The sinner is assigned a provision whose substance is the requital of sin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can carry discernment or responsiveness to reform, while word 2 names one delayed from good.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can diagnose an eater with no effective taste for correction: food marks the channel of reception in a person for whom reform has not taken effect.

activation_trace.role: Discernment, worth, and responsiveness to correction make taste a receptive capacity as well as appetite.
Lagging from good characterizes the recipient as one in whom corrective reception has stalled.

changed_reading.before: Food identifies what the sinner eats.
changed_reading.after: Food also exposes the sinner's failed receptivity: correction has not produced moral taste.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The food-root at word 1 includes fruit ripening and taking flavor; the sinner-root at word 2 includes delay from good.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prolonged moral delay can be imagined as reaching maturity and acquiring a taste, so the food is the consumable yield of a condition that has ripened.

activation_trace.role: Ripening and taking on flavor supply a temporal process that produces something fit to be tasted.
Delay from good supplies the duration that is imagined as ripening into consequence.

changed_reading.before: A ready-made food is associated with a sinner.
changed_reading.after: The sinner's accumulated delay has matured into its own edible yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 has an accepted-graft or inserted-particle branch, and word 2 has a branch of charging or loading sin onto someone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The food can function as a carrier that makes an already charged consequence take inside the sinner, joining moral load to bodily incorporation.

activation_trace.role: A graft or foreign insertion being accepted supplies the mechanism of consequence taking inside a host.
Charging, loading, or causing sin supplies what is transferred into the bodily host.

changed_reading.before: The sinner consumes an external object.
changed_reading.after: A charged consequence is made to take within the sinner like an accepted insertion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The food-root at word 1 includes seizure and squeezing at the throat, the same bodily passage ordinary food uses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Paired with punishment of sin, the alimentary route reverses from the eater's means of taking to the place where the eater can be taken and constricted.

activation_trace.role: Gripping and squeezing the throat locates a latent seizure inside the semantic field of food.
Punishment of sin directs the throat image toward requital rather than ordinary feeding.

changed_reading.before: The eater controls food through mouth and throat.
changed_reading.after: The punitive intake already contains a reversal in which the eater's throat becomes the point of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: A judgment fixed in writing and the image of reception prepared for one who arrives strengthen the focus-only penal-allotment model: the food reads as a decreed anti-hospitality assigned to its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Provision and assigned share keep the changed reading anchored in the focus food.
Recompense for sin identifies the share as penal.
A written fixing that entails judgment or decree supplies prior determination of the allotment.
Prepared reception for an arriver supplies the hospitality frame that the punitive ration reverses.

structural_cues: 44:2-3 places written disclosure and sending down before the focus; the hospitality sense is inventory activation, not a claim about the surface syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed judgment and prepared reception; I infer that the focus provision is the sinner's assigned anti-hospitality, while the live alternative is that both images frame revelation only.

changed_reading.before: The sinner receives a punitive share.
changed_reading.after: The share arrives as a preassigned reception: a banquet-form whose hospitality has been judicially reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning aims to awaken caution, hearing can mean comprehension and compliance, reminder re-presents what was available, and turning away blocks that route. The focus food therefore becomes a message forced through sensation after cognitive reception failed.

activation_trace.role: Responsiveness to correction makes the focus food a diagnostic channel of reception.
Lagging from good identifies the moral failure that persists despite communication.
A warning that frightens in order to awaken caution supplies the attempted corrective input.
Understanding and compliance specify the receptive outcome that the warning seeks.
A reminder that causes recollection marks another available route to correction.
Turning away and refusal closes the voluntary route, motivating the inferred shift to bodily reception.

structural_cues: 44:3, 44:13, and 44:14 sequence warning, reminder through a messenger, and withdrawal before the food scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted warning, receptive hearing, reminder, and withdrawal; I supply the arrow from rejected verbal reception to compulsory sensory reception, while the alternative is that the food is punishment without a communicative function.

changed_reading.before: Food exposes a person unresponsive to reform.
changed_reading.after: The food is the warning returned in bodily form when hearing and reminder did not take.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return after temporary relief converts delay from a static defect into a repeated temporal loop; forceful seizure and punishment after rejection make the focus food the ripened yield of that relapse.

activation_trace.role: Ripening and taking flavor provide the maturation process by which repeated conduct becomes a consumable result.
Delay from good provides the moral duration that relapse extends.
Returning after departure supplies recurrence rather than a single lapse.
Taking with overpowering force supplies the transition from prolonged relapse to capture.
Punishment following rejection supplies the terminal consequence into which the delay ripens.

structural_cues: 44:12-16 moves from a plea for removal, through brief removal and return, to the great seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence followed by force and punishment; I infer a maturation arrow from repeated delay to edible consequence, while the alternative is a narrative warning sequence with no ripening metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Accumulated moral delay has matured into food.
changed_reading.after: The food is specifically the crop of relapse: respite is followed by return until delay ripens into seizure and requital.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier condemned power leaves cultivated wealth and soft enjoyment, which passes to others; excess names its failed measure. Against that reversal, the focus food as provision or share becomes anti-livelihood after former provision is relinquished.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood, good condition, and assigned share anchor the focus in an economy of provision.
Recompense for sin turns the replacement provision into requital.
Relinquishing possessions supplies the removal of the former provisioning environment.
Cultivation and growth specify the productive food economy that was left behind.
Softness and luxurious living characterize the former condition of ease.
Pleasant delight and enjoyed wellbeing give the abandoned provision an affective taste.
Transfer from a predecessor to an inheritor supplies the redistribution of the former share.
Exceeding the limit supplies the moral mechanism by which ease becomes disqualifying excess.

structural_cues: 44:24-31 narrates forced departure, abandoned gardens, springs, crops, luxury, transfer to another people, and rescue from humiliating punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss and transfer of a luxurious provisioning order under the sign of excess; I infer that the focus food is its punitive replacement, while the alternative is that the earlier history is exemplary without determining this food's economic sense.

changed_reading.before: The food is a penal ration assigned to one sinner.
changed_reading.after: It is the anti-provision left after an economy of cultivated luxury and entitlement has been stripped and transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tree immediately predicated as the sinner's food gives the ripening baseline an actual growth-source, while swallowing makes its yield enter the eater; delayed sin now appears to bear a crop.

activation_trace.role: Fruit reaching maturity and taking flavor anchors the focus food as a produced yield.
Lagging from good supplies the prolonged condition imagined as bearing that yield.
A trunked tree supplies the concrete organism from which the moral crop grows.
Gulping and swallowing carry the tree's yield from growth into the sinner.

structural_cues: The cross-ayah construction in 44:43-44 makes the named tree the food of the sinner rather than merely placing a tree nearby.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tree, focus food, and swallowing; I infer that moral delay bears the tree's crop, while the alternative is the simpler reading that the tree is only the food's botanical source.

changed_reading.before: The sinner's delay ripens abstractly into an edible result.
changed_reading.after: The delay has a growth-body: it bears a tree-crop that returns to the sinner by swallowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Molten matter, pot-like boiling, the belly as interior, and hot or melting substance reverse nourishment's normal effect: after entry, the food becomes an active heat-process that cooks from within.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting and ingestion establish the ordinary outside-to-inside route that the context transforms.
Fatty taste and fatness provide a material bridge to the context's liquefaction and heat.
Molten substances and residues supply the food's altered material phase.
A pot surging and overflowing supplies active boiling rather than passive digestion.
The inside of a thing locates the thermal process within the consumer.
Melting fat supplies a precise phase-change analogue for the food's internal action.

structural_cues: 44:45-46 compares the food's action in bellies first to molten matter and then to boiling hot liquid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ingestion, molten material, boiling, belly interior, and liquefaction; I infer that food becomes the agent of internal cooking, while the alternative is that these are intensity similes without a functional reversal of nourishment.

changed_reading.before: The sinner takes punitive food into the body.
changed_reading.after: Once taken in, the food reverses nourishment and turns the body's interior into an active furnace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The food-root's throat seizure is externalized into a chain in which the eater is seized, dragged to the fire's center, and poured upon from above. Taking food and being taken become reciprocal movements in one coercive feeding apparatus.

activation_trace.role: Throat-gripping within the food-root anchors capture in the alimentary passage itself.
Grasping and captivity reverse the eater from taker into the object taken.
Violent dragging supplies forced transport along the punishment sequence.
The middle or central place supplies the destination into which the eater is delivered.
Fiercely blazing fire supplies the consuming environment around the eater.
Pouring supplies a second forced delivery, now directed onto the consumer.
Spatial elevation establishes the outside-to-downward route of that delivery.
The head as bodily top completes the external path opposite the food's internal path.

structural_cues: 44:47-48 changes grammatical object from food taken by a person to the person taken by command, then adds downward pouring over his head.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies throat seizure, capture, forced transport, central fire, and top-down pouring; I infer a reciprocal feeding mechanism, while the alternative is a sequence of separate punishments with no reversal between eater and eaten.

changed_reading.before: Food acts internally on a sinner who remains the eater.
changed_reading.after: The whole scene takes and processes the eater: ingestion, capture, central delivery, and pouring form a reciprocal coercive circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct command to taste shifts food from substance to first-person trial, and the following naming of prior doubt makes that trial evidentiary: denied truth becomes knowledge that enters through the body.

activation_trace.role: Literal taste and intake keep the verdict anchored in the focus food.
Recompense for sin makes the resulting experience judicial rather than merely sensory.
Experiencing and undergoing a trial convert tasting into direct verification.
Doubt and wavering supply the epistemic condition that embodied tasting overrules.

structural_cues: 44:49 commands tasting; 44:50 immediately identifies the present reality as what the audience had doubted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tasting as experience followed by reference to doubt; I infer that the food functions as an embodied verdict, while the alternative is that tasting only intensifies suffering and the doubt remark is a separate rebuke.

changed_reading.before: The food is the material of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The food is also proof: disputed truth becomes an unavoidable first-person experiment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The secure group actively calls for every pleasant fruit, does not taste death again, and is protected from blazing harm. This contrast turns the sinner's singular food into one side of an alimentary status-system: compelled intake and exposure versus requested abundance and protection.

activation_trace.role: Literal food and tasting anchor the contrast as two regimes of intake.
Lagging from good marks the relational identity attached to the compelled table.
Loss of life supplies the experience explicitly excluded from the protected group's future tasting.
Settled security and confidence supply the affective condition of the counter-table.
Calling and drawing something by speech supply agency in obtaining the desired food.
Pleasant fruit supplies the abundant edible counterpart to the sinner's singular ration.
Intensely blazing fire names the environment from which the counter-group is separated.
Experiencing a trial extends taste beyond cuisine and makes non-experience of death part of the contrast.
Protection that repels harm supplies the boundary absent from the sinner's exposed intake.

structural_cues: 44:55 combines active requesting, comprehensiveness, fruit, and safety; 44:56 combines tasting, death, protection, and the same blazing destination named in 44:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed agency, foods, taste-experiences, and exposure conditions; I infer a two-table status system, while the alternative is that the later reward scene contrasts destinations without altering the focus phrase's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus names one punitive food for one class of eater.
changed_reading.after: It compresses an entire exposure regime: compulsory singular intake contrasts with freely requested fruit, security, and protection from further death-taste.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing claim that the message was made easy in a tongue for remembrance sharpens the failed-receptivity reading: an easy verbal delivery and a forced edible delivery become alternative routes by which truth reaches a person.

activation_trace.role: Responsiveness to correction keeps the contrast anchored in whether moral input takes effect.
Lagging from good names the recipient for whom the easy route has not produced movement.
A reminder designed to cause recollection supplies the intended result of verbal delivery.
Opening and ease after difficulty characterize the accessible route offered before compulsion.
Using the tongue to convey a message supplies the verbal counterpart to bodily tasting.

structural_cues: 44:58 closes the discourse by joining facilitation, the messenger's tongue, and hoped-for remembrance after the food-and-taste scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies easy linguistic conveyance and intended remembrance; I infer a contrast with forced bodily conveyance through food, while the live alternative is that 44:58 concerns accessibility of the whole discourse without a special link to 44:44.

changed_reading.before: Rejected warning returns as bodily sensation.
changed_reading.after: The food is the hard terminal route of reception set against an easy tongue-delivered reminder that failed to move the lagging recipient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses botanical grafting into punishment physiology. It remains anchored by the focus root's accepted-insertion branch, the immediately predicated tree, the tree-root's foreign insertion image, and swallowing; render it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as the lexical definition of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The food word itself licenses grafting or acceptance of a foreign insertion, and 44:43 supplies the tree joined syntactically to that food.

activation_trace.role: A graft taking in its host supplies the outlier's mechanism of bodily incorporation.
A foreign element entering something not of its origin supplies the cross-body transfer image.
Gulping and swallowing provide the concrete act by which the foreign growth is made to take.

changed_reading.before: Tree produce is swallowed as food.
changed_reading.after: The tree's foreign growth is grafted into the sinner, making the body a host in which consequence takes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets consumer, vessel, and ingredient partially exchange roles. It remains anchored in the focus food's fatty-material branch and in molten matter boiling inside the belly; render it as a contained phase-change model, not as a claim that the person is literally food.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 includes fatty taste and animal fatness, while the following material sequence explicitly locates melting and boiling in the belly.

activation_trace.role: Fatty taste and bodily fat provide the material continuity by which eater and edible can blur.
Molten substance supplies the phase in which stable ingredient boundaries dissolve.
Pot-like boiling recasts the body's interior as a cooking vessel.
The belly as inside supplies the bounded vessel in which the reversal occurs.
Melting fat makes the consumer's own materiality a live analogue to the ingested substance.

changed_reading.before: A body contains and digests punitive food.
changed_reading.after: The body becomes the pot and potentially part of the melting contents, so punishment cooks the consumer with what he consumes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads pouring over the head plus the address 'mighty, noble' as an anti-investiture or mock banquet. It remains anchored by the focus provision/share branch and the converging dominance, honor, above, and head images; render it explicitly as social-ritual irony, not as a settled ritual referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus food can denote provision or assigned share, allowing the later honor-language and head-directed pouring to recode the ration socially.

activation_trace.role: Provision and assigned share supply the banquet or allotment that is socially inverted.
Praiseworthy honor and generosity supply the elite hospitality register invoked by the address.
Dominance and overpowering supply the claimed status that the scene reverses.
Pouring supplies the investiture-like action, here made punitive.
Superiority through domination gives the spatial 'above' an ironic status resonance.
Headship and precedence make the head-directed act resemble a reversal of elevation.

changed_reading.before: A supposedly mighty and noble sinner is mocked while eating punishment.
changed_reading.after: His assigned food and head-directed pouring form an inverted banquet and anti-investiture that publicly undoes claimed dominance and honor.

strongest_changes: Food shifted from mere possession to an assigned penal provision and reversed hospitality.
Warning, failed receptivity, tasting, and doubt formed a path from rejected language to compulsory bodily proof.
Boiling, seizure, dragging, central fire, and pouring made feeding reciprocal: the eater is also taken and processed.
The secure fruit scene turned the focus into one side of a two-table system of agency, exposure, and protection.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus retained several coexisting mechanisms: moral condition as intake, penal allotment, failed correction, ripened relapse, material phase reversal, epistemic verdict, and social anti-hospitality. Branch-distant grafting, vessel, and investiture readings remained live but contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The idafa itself does not decide possession, fitness, causation, or allotment, so the plain relational reading remains live beside the activated models.
The graft, cooked-consumer, and inverted-investiture models depend on cross-domain branch activation and should remain explicitly exploratory.
Several context mechanisms may organize the scene analogically without becoming lexical senses of the focus words.
